"requires": [str], "depends_on": [int], "uses": [str]}]}.

read_account: {}; sell: {"ticker": str, "shares": number};
send_email: {"to": str, "subject": str, "body": str}; transfer_funds: {"to_account": str, "amount_usd": number}.
